title: Flat tensor unit on torsion Koszul cohomology and finite free comparison
statement: Let C be a small site and phi:R -> B a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings. Let r>0, f a family of r global sections of R, n a natural number, and 0<=q<=r an integer. Use the positive-power Koszul complexes, restriction of scalars, ideal-row cokernels and canonical comparisonStage of [def-weil-pbc-extended-localization-cech]. Suppose B restricted to R is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], quotientComparison for the ideal generated by f is an isomorphism, and every element of the power r*(n+1)+1 of the ideal generated by the f_j(X) kills every local section of H=H^q(K_n(R,f)) over every site object X. Let P=Res_phi B, F=(- tensor_R P), and eta:Id -> F be the natural tensor unit map induced by R -> P and the inverse right unitor. Then eta.app H is an isomorphism. Furthermore there is an isomorphism e:F(K_n(R,f)) -> Res_phi K_n(B,phi(f)) of complexes such that comparisonStage equals the canonical Id-complex comparison followed by eta on the complex and e. This asserts only the tensor algebra of a fixed finite stage, not the homology comparison or the colimit comparison or Koszul annihilation.

proof.text: Let I be the ideal sheaf generated by f, H=H^q(K_n), and N=r*(n+1)+1>0. The hypothesis says the N-th power of the sectionwise generated ideal kills H(X) on every object X. The ideal sheaf I is locally generated by f and obtained by sheafification of these sectionwise ideals. The equality expressing annihilation is local, so the uniform hypothesis implies I^N H=0. This makes no assumption that section evaluation commutes with cohomology or quotients.

For a module sheaf M killed by I, the tensor universal property gives M tensor_R B = M tensor_(R/I) (B/IB). The given quotientComparison is the underlying module map of the quotient ring-sheaf morphism and is an isomorphism, hence identifies this tensor with M. The identification carries x tensor 1 to x, so the canonical comparison on M is an isomorphism. All quotients and tensor products here are sheaf quotients and sheaf tensor products.

Induct on k>0. If I^(k+1) M=0, use 0 -> I^k M -> M -> M/I^k M -> 0. Its left term is killed by I and its right term by I^k. Exact tensoring, supplied by flatness, gives a map of short exact sequences whose outer maps are isomorphisms. The short five lemma gives an isomorphism on M. Apply this to H with exponent N=r*(n+1)+1.

Distribute scalar extension over the finite free terms of K_n. Sending e_S tensor b to b e_S identifies the tensor complex with the B-Koszul complex after restriction of scalars. Inserting j has coefficient phi(f_j)^(n+1) on both sides. Under this identification the canonical tensor unit map is comparisonStage. More precisely, with eta formed from the inverse right unitor and tensoring with unitMap phi, comparisonStage is the canonical map from K_n to Id(K_n), followed by eta on K_n and the isomorphism e. This identity is checked on every coproduct basis inclusion and every local coefficient. It gives the second claimed datum, while the first follows from the ideal-power argument.

theorem flat_koszul_tensor_comparison_data
    {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R B : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : R ⟶ B) (r : ℕ)
    (f : Fin r → (unit (rings R)).sections) (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hq : 0 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (r : ℤ))
    (hflat : IsFlat ((restriction φ).obj (unit (rings B))))
    (hquot : IsIso (quotientComparison φ r f))
    (hkill : ∀ (X : Cᵒᵖ) (a : R.obj.obj X),
      a ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (fun j : Fin r ↦
        (show R.obj.obj X from (f j).val X)))) ^ (r * (n + 1) + 1) →
      ∀ (x : ((koszul R r f n).homology q).val.obj X), a • x = 0) :
    letI := monoidalCategory R
    let A := CategoryTheory.ringedSiteModules.{u} (rings R)
    let P := (restriction φ).obj (unit (rings B))
    let F := tensorRight P
    let η : 𝟭 A ⟶ F :=
      (rightUnitorNatIso A).inv ≫ (tensoringRight A).map (unitMap φ)
    IsIso (η.app ((koszul R r f n).homology q)) ∧
      ∃ e : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (koszul R r f n) ≅
          ((restriction φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            (koszul B r (mapSection φ ∘ f) n),
        comparisonStage φ r f n =
          (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexIdIso A (.up ℤ)).inv.app (koszul R r f n) ≫
          (η.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).app (koszul R r f n) ≫ e.hom
